newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's DGB sees record jobless in January.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DGB sees record jobless in January.

text.p: Germany's DGB trade union congress said on Friday that unemployment would set a new post-war record this month, breaking the previous record of 4.2 million set last February.
DGB labour market expert Wilhelm Adamy told Reuters that December unemployment would exceed 4.1 million on an unadjusted basis -- also setting a record for that month.
December jobless data are due for release next Thursday.
DGB deputy leader Ursula Engelen-Kefer sits on the board of the Federal Labour Office -- the state agency responsible for paying jobless benefits and calculating unemployment figures.
